about_the_game:
Your kingdom has been destroyed, and only a few soldiers have managed to retreat with you. Now, you must rebuild your army from scratch, lead your troops into battle, experience the true thrill of war, where every punch lands and every strike bleeds, and feel the shock of massive army confrontations! Defeat your enemies and restore the glory of your kingdom!

• Start from scratch to build a powerful legion and lead your troops into epic battles!
• Choose your units wisely, strategize, and command your army to victory on the battlefield!
• 30+ types of soldiers with diverse growth combinations, creating an unbeatable army!
• 10+ powerful skills that allow you to dominate the battlefield and showcase your commander’s true strength!
• New levels are continuously updated, offering constant challenges to test your tactical brilliance!
• Face players from around the world and fight for the top spot on the global leaderboard!
• Powerful commander skills that can turn the tide of battle and help you claim victory!
• A variety of monsters and bosses await, challenging your strategic limits!
